name: icloud-connector
description: Give Claude access to your iCloud Mail (IMAP/SMTP) and your local iCloud Drive folder.
long_description:
Local MCP server giving Claude Desktop access to a personal iCloud account.

Mail uses Apple's officially supported IMAP/SMTP servers (imap.mail.me.com / smtp.mail.me.com) with an app-specific password you generate at https://account.apple.com - Apple offers no OAuth for third-party apps, so this password is a full-mailbox credential; it is stored by Claude Desktop in your OS keychain (marked sensitive), never persisted or logged by the connector, and individually revocable at account.apple.com.

iCloud Drive has no public API, so the Drive tools operate on your local iCloud Drive sync folder (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\iCloudDrive via iCloud for Windows; macOS: ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs). The iCloud client must be installed and syncing. All paths are strictly confined to that folder.

Safety properties:
- Sending mail and deleting files are separate, clearly-annotated destructive tools; Claude is instructed to confirm with you before calling them.
- Drive deletes go to the OS recycle bin, never permanent.
- Attachment saves cap at 25 MB, file reads at 100 MB; filenames are sanitized; drive paths cannot escape the iCloud folder (symlinks resolved).
- stdout carries only MCP protocol traffic; diagnostics go to stderr (visible in Claude Desktop's MCP logs).

apple_id.title: Apple ID email
apple_id.description: The email address of your Apple ID (e.g. you@icloud.com / @me.com / @mac.com).

app_password.title: App-specific password
app_password.description: Generate at https://account.apple.com -> Sign-In and Security -> App-Specific Passwords -> Generate. This is NOT your Apple ID password. It grants full mail access and can be revoked individually at any time on the same page.

drive_path.title: iCloud Drive folder (optional override)
drive_path.description: Leave empty to use the default location (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\iCloudDrive, macOS: ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs). Set only if your iCloud Drive syncs to a custom folder.

tools.name: icloud_status
tools.description: Verifies the iCloud Mail sign-in and reports the account and available mailboxes.

tools.name: icloud_mail_list
tools.description: Lists messages from a mailbox (default inbox), newest first.

tools.name: icloud_mail_search
tools.description: Searches a mailbox by subject, sender, or body text.

tools.name: icloud_mail_read
tools.description: Fetches the full content of a single message: headers, plain-text body, attachment list.

tools.name: icloud_mail_get_attachment
tools.description: Saves a single attachment from a message to disk (max 25 MB).

tools.name: icloud_mail_create_draft
tools.description: Creates a draft in the Drafts mailbox (not sent) - the preferred way to compose for review before sending.

tools.name: icloud_mail_send
tools.description: Sends an email immediately and irreversibly via SMTP, saving a copy to Sent Messages.

tools.name: icloud_mail_move
tools.description: Moves a message to another mailbox.

tools.name: icloud_mail_mark
tools.description: Updates the read and/or flagged state of a message.

tools.name: icloud_drive_list
tools.description: Lists files and folders in an iCloud Drive folder.

tools.name: icloud_drive_search
tools.description: Searches iCloud Drive by file/folder name, optionally scoped to a subfolder.

tools.name: icloud_drive_get_metadata
tools.description: Fetches size, timestamps, and type information for an iCloud Drive item.

tools.name: icloud_drive_read_file
tools.description: Reads an iCloud Drive file - small text files inline, others copied to disk (max 100 MB).

tools.name: icloud_drive_write_file
tools.description: Writes text content or copies a local file into iCloud Drive (max 250 MB).

tools.name: icloud_drive_create_folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder in iCloud Drive.

tools.name: icloud_drive_move
tools.description: Moves and/or renames an iCloud Drive item.

tools.name: icloud_drive_delete
tools.description: Deletes an iCloud Drive item to the OS recycle bin (recoverable, never permanent).
